description: Black-Scholes theoretical price and Greeks for a REAL, live option instrument on Deribit (BTC/ETH, coin-settled) or Binance (BTC, ETH, XAU, XAG, USDT-settled): pulls that instrument's own spot, strike, days to expiry, and implied volatility from the venue, then reports how far the venue's actual quoted mark price sits from what Black-Scholes implies at that IV (priceDiscrepancyPct). This is the trust-check tool: "is this exchange's quoted price consistent with its own volatility assumption?", not an estimate, a live formula cross-check. Use when user gives a specific instrument name (e.g. "BTC-27FEB27-90000-C" on Deribit, "BTC-261225-90000-C" on Binance) and asks "is this option fairly priced?" or "what are the Greeks on this contract?". Returns everything workflow.run_black_scholes does, plus instrumentName, exchange, premiumCurrency (BTC/ETH for Deribit, USDT for Binance), optionType, markPrice, markIvPct, bsPrice, priceDiscrepancyPct, available (false + error if the instrument name doesn't resolve, the contract has expired or has no IV quote, a Binance contract states no usable risk-free rate (missing or outside -100 to 100%), or a Binance market is not trading; then do not use any result field, they are null; read available first). For Deribit also currency, deribitMarkPriceCoin, deribitMarkIvPct, bsPriceCoin; for Binance those and the coin-quoted callPriceCoin/putPriceCoin are null (prices are in USDT per unit, delta, gamma, vega, theta and rho are the standard USD ones for both). A contract whose mark is only a cent or two can show a large priceDiscrepancyPct; read the absolute gap there. The rate Binance states can be negative; it is returned as riskFreeRatePct, and workflow.run_black_scholes accepts 0 to 100 only, so a negative one cannot be fed back into it.

exchange.description: Venue of the instrument. Default deribit.

instrumentName.description: Exact instrument name: Deribit BTC-27FEB27-90000-C, Binance BTC-261225-90000-C (expiry YYMMDD). Get one from the venue's options chain; this tool does not browse the chain, it prices one named instrument.

riskFreeRatePct.description: Risk-free rate in percentage points, Deribit only. Default 0: standard crypto-options convention. Binance states its own rate for each contract and the price uses that one; a value here is not used for Binance.
